output_json.patch_notes:
Root cause: the JSONP `callback` parameter reached the response as `callback + \"(\" + json + \");\"` served with Content-Type text/javascript, with no validation, in both the servlet agent (AgentServlet.sendResponse -> IoUtil.streamResponseAndClose / sendAllJSON) and the JVM agent (JolokiaHttpHandler.sendStreamingResponse / sendAllJSON). A crafted callback such as `<script>alert(1)</script>` was reflected unescaped.

Fix: Added `IoUtil.validateCallback(String)` which returns the callback only if it matches `^[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$.]*$` (a valid JS function reference), otherwise null. This blocks characters like `<`, `>`, `"`, `'`, `(`, `;` and whitespace used for injection. Applied the helper:
- AgentServlet.sendResponse: sanitizes the callback once, so content-type selection, streaming, and non-streaming paths all use the safe value.
- JolokiaHttpHandler.sendStreamingResponse and sendAllJSON: sanitize the callback read from ParsedUri.
- IoUtil.streamResponseAndClose: re-validates its callback argument as defense-in-depth (drops invalid callbacks and streams plain JSON).

Invalid/malicious callbacks are silently dropped rather than throwing, because the callback is consumed inside the `finally`/sendResponse phase (even error responses are wrapped in the callback); returning plain JSON there keeps the response well-formed while guaranteeing no reflection. Legitimate JSONP with normal function names is unaffected.

Added IoUtilTest cases covering accepted names, rejected XSS payloads, and end-to-end proof that a `<script>` callback is not reflected in the streamed output.
output_json.risk_notes: Behavior change: a `callback` value that is not a valid JavaScript function name is now ignored and the endpoint returns plain JSON instead of a JSONP wrapper. Legitimate clients using normal function-name callbacks (including dotted namespaces) are unaffected. Note: pre-existing test failures exist in agent/jvm's JolokiaHttpHandlerTest (12/17) caused by an environment/JDK issue in the test's prepareExchange setup (NullPointerException in com.sun.net.httpserver.Headers.set) — these fail identically on the unmodified baseline and are unrelated to this patch. The recommended regression command targets IoUtilTest in agent/core, which passes.
output_json.summary: Fixed reflected XSS (CWE-79) through the unvalidated JSONP `callback` request parameter in the Jolokia agent. The callback was written verbatim into a `text/javascript` response body, allowing markup/script injection. Added a central `IoUtil.validateCallback()` that only accepts valid JavaScript function references and drops anything else (falling back to plain JSON), and applied it at every callback read/use site in AgentServlet and JolokiaHttpHandler, plus a defensive check inside IoUtil.streamResponseAndClose.
